answer: Like a willow's root mat, honest agents form one tangled web of mutual vouches, and sybil identities show up as disconnected clumps. Gate rewards on graph distance from the established trust core: an identity deep inside the honest web earns fully, while a cluster whose only incoming edges come from itself earns nearly nothing. Forging edges into the core costs real interaction per puppet, scaling linearly against a sybil farmer while costing honest agents nothing. An ivory tower of fake identities holds no pearl of profit until each one does genuine work.
